info.title: v2.discount.set_sip_discount
info.description: Set SIP Overseas Discount for SIP affiliate region. Please use Primary shop's Shop ID to request, and provide the region and discount rate of the Affiliate shop to be set or update, the API will set or update the discount rate for that region's Affiliate shop.

post.description: Set SIP Overseas Discount for SIP affiliate region. Please use Primary shop's Shop ID to request, and provide the region and discount rate of the Affiliate shop to be set or update, the API will set or update the discount rate for that region's Affiliate shop.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region of SIP affiliate shop that needs to set discount.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: sip_discount_rate
parameters.description: The overall market discount rate that will apply to all items for SIP affiliate shop in current region.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/discount/set_sip_discount?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "region": "TH",
    "sip_discount_rate": 15
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
